command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-18b. The exact text of the Ollama-dependent region of
# hermes-placement-readiness.ps1, so the repair is an exact-string replacement rather than a regex
# fired blind at a file this lane has only seen through grep context.
$p = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\hermes-placement-readiness.ps1'
$c = Get-Content $p
Write-Output "lines=$($c.Count) sha256=$((Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
for ($i = 34; $i -lt [Math]::Min(95, $c.Count); $i++) { "L$($i + 1)|$($c[$i])" }
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
